filtering: Both H-fitted pole-projected AR models remain frozen online.
H_calibration: Align residuals on common H endpoints; divide errors by high-order H innovation SD; center each derived channel by H mean and divide by H SD floored at 1e-6; online calibrated channel clips at +/-12.
sequential_policy: Half-lives 8/32/128, +/-CUSUM drift .25, fixed mean GLR and integrated zero-centered Gaussian mean priors .25/1; age widths weight the mixture; memory is fixed-size.
mathematical_tests: Direct frozen AR predictions, direct suffix GLR/Bayes, ring wrap, unchanged-prefix, fixed-memory, and synthetic lag-8 coefficient sign-change tests passed.

candidates.hypothesis: A change in dependence can reverse the predictive advantage of two frozen historical AR orders before marginal features respond.
candidates.change: Append H-normalized forecast-gap, squared-error advantage, log-energy advantage and high-order innovation times forecast-gap evidence; order, age, family-removal and ranking ablations are explicit.
candidates.expected_effect: Measure loss of historical predictive structure directly without online coefficient fitting.
candidates.risks: Nearby AR fits can have very small mismatch variance; raw H empirical scaling may be sensitive to outliers; related channels are correlated and are not independent Bayes factors.
